title: EEGBiFormer: Real-Time EEG Attention Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformer with EEG-Informed Auditory Protocol Validation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. translated_title: EEGBiFormer：基于混合CNN-Transformer的实时脑电注意力分类及脑电驱动的听觉协议验证
translated_abstract: 持续注意力对学业表现至关重要，然而现有的听觉支持工具是静态的，且缺乏基于实时神经证据的支撑。本文提出了EEGBiFormer，这是一种混合CNN-Transformer模型，用于从16通道脑电（EEG）信号中对注意力状态（专注与非专注）进行实时二分类。研究设计并搭建了一套定制的模拟前端采集板，用于收集基于任务的脑电数据集。在模型训练之前，通过功率谱密度（PSD）和相位锁定值（PLV）进行的频谱与连接性分析证实了不同注意力状态之间存在明显的神经特征差异，为该分类方法提供了生理学依据。EEGBiFormer在窗口级别达到了91.3%的验证准确率，F1分数为94.5%，在17个独立会话中的记录级别准确率为88.2%。端到端系统延迟实测低于100毫秒，可支持实时响应。
tldr: 本文提出EEGBiFormer混合CNN-Transformer模型，基于16通道脑电信号实现实时专注状态二分类，窗口级准确率达91.3%、系统延迟低于100毫秒，并通过频谱与连接性分析为分类方法提供了神经生理学依据。
en_tdlr: EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model, enables real-time binary classification of attention states from 16-channel EEG signals, achieving 91.3% window-level accuracy with sub-100ms latency, and is physiologically grounded by spectral and connectivity analysis.
